description: The tagged result every menger process the scene agent runs prints on stdout when it ends at once (SceneValidator, run-sandboxed.sh, run-render-window.sh, menger-app's render-lock refusal), and the exit code that goes with each tag. Owned by menger (review 2026-10-14, menger#82/#100); ProcessContractSuite holds every producer to it; the agent keeps a copy in reference/ and holds its parser to it. A wall-clock timeout (exit 124) prints nothing.

windowEvents.description: What the interactive window writes, one JSON object per line, to <scene file>.events.jsonl next to the scene it watches. Replaces reading the window's log lines (review 2026-10-14, menger#82). Scene code runs in the same process and could write one too: an event is a report, not proof.
